From time to time strange insectoids appear west of {wiki:Greenshore}, north of Thais. If nobody kills them, they eat the leaves and grass and leave an insectoid desert behind. Kill enough {creature:Insectoid Scout|Insectoid Scouts} to stop the invasion and let the land turn green again; while the invasion lasts you can kill them and add up Bestiary charm points.
The insectoids are invading Greenshore and will destroy the land if they are not killed.
Only possible when this World Change is active on your world.
general advice, to get out of the Rotworm hole
A chance to kill {creature:Insectoid Scout|Insectoid Scouts}, which are worth 15 charm points in the {wiki:Bestiary}
Stop the invasion and bring the green back to the area west of Greenshore
If players do not kill enough insectoids, the area turns into an insectoid desert. Help kill them until the land turns green again.
Go to {wiki:Greenshore}, **north** of Thais. You go on foot: leave Thais and follow the dirt path **north**, through the mountain pass, to the village.
Map of Greenshore and the way to Thais
On the way there are {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Spider|Spiders} and {creature:Bug|Bugs}.
Enter the village by the ramp and head into the town.
Cross the bridge to the west
Follow the first path **west** to a small bridge and cross it. {creature:Insectoid Scout|Insectoid Scouts} can be anywhere in this area.
Look in the Rotworm hole too
You can also find Insectoid Scouts in the hole where 2 {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} appear. Sometimes it is possible to lure them to the village.
To leave the hole, use the {item:Rope} on the rope spot and you are back on the surface.
Kill enough Insectoid Scouts to stop the invasion. This creature only appears during the World Change and is worth **15 charm points** in the {wiki:Bestiary}.
Insectoid Scout Bestiary progress (15 charm points)
When you are done, go back the same way: cross the bridge **east**, leave the village by the ramp ({coord:32304,32119,7}) and follow the dirt path **south** to Thais.
